title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
abstract: arXiv:2606.17168v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When LLM weights are open or fine-tuning is available through an API, suppressing hazardous knowledge and tendencies is not enough: removal has to be deep enough that an adversary cannot restore it. Existing unlearning is shallow by this standard: fine-tuning or a handful of in-context examples brings the behaviour back, and it often degrades general capabilities in the process. We identify a root cause: existing methods edit representations shared with the retain set and lying in the subspace that a fine-tuning attacker recovers, making unlearning simultaneously easy to undo and disruptive. Leveraging this, we propose RepSelect (Representation Selectivity), which isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing the top principal components of the weight gradients before each unlearning update, preserving general capabilities while limiting what fine-tuning can recover. translated_title: RepSelect：通过表示选择性实现鲁棒的大语言模型遗忘
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型的权重开放或通过API提供微调时，仅抑制有害知识和倾向是不够的：删除必须足够深入，以至于攻击者无法恢复。现有的遗忘方法在此标准下显得肤浅：微调或少量上下文示例即可恢复行为，且此过程常常损害通用能力。我们识别出一个根本原因：现有方法编辑与保留集共享的表示，且这些表示位于微调攻击者能恢复的子空间中，这使得遗忘既容易被撤销又具有破坏性。基于此，我们提出RepSelect（表示选择性），通过在每个遗忘更新前压缩权重梯度的前主成分，隔离遗忘集特定的表示，从而在保留通用能力的同时限制微调可恢复的内容。我们在涵盖知识和行为五个遗忘数据集上进行了验证。
tldr: RepSelect通过压缩权重梯度主成分来隔离遗忘集特定表示，实现了既难以被微调恢复又不损害通用能力的鲁棒遗忘。
en_tdlr: RepSelect isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing top gradient principal components, enabling unlearning that is both resistant to fine-tuning recovery and preservative of general capabilities.
